components.description: Interactive guess: the first part of the series is shown, the reader draws the rest in the shaded zone (dataviz/track), then the actual line is revealed with the gap as a chip. Builds intuition before the answer — for courses, reports and explainers. Pointer + keyboard drawing (arrow keys move the pen); a “Skip” action reveals without drawing. Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Show at least 3 known points before the guess zone.
Snap the guess to the x steps of the data.
Always allow “Skip” — guessing must be optional.
Keep the y scale fixed; never rescale after the guess.
Why it works
Committing to a guess makes the real answer memorable — ideal for BEK Academy lessons.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Interactive guess: the start of a series is shown, the reader draws the rest, then the actual line is revealed with the gap.
Encoding
x = time, y = value; known part solid, guess dashed (second colour), actual revealed solid; guess zone = track background.
Interaction
Pointer/touch draw; keyboard: ←/→ choose x, ↑/↓ set y, Enter reveals; Skip button.
